name: J. B. Sutphin
role: N. P. R. C. Co. agent at Duluth
mentions: …. Huidekoper and sons, Meadville, Pa., Fred. Willard, city; John W. Buster, Texas; W. H. Smith, Mandan; J. B. Sutphin, Duluth; T. P. Langham, Superior; Chas. Gallagher, Hashknife ranch.
J. B. Sutphin, agent of the N. P. R. C. Co., at Duluth, has been spending a few days at Medora and returned home this morning.
